keel_session.original_prompt: AI chat bot for health monitoring

io_contract.value: A POST endpoint takes a free-text health message and returns an AI-generated interpretation with suggested next steps.

scale.value: One user, a few messages a day.

constraints.value: Python standard library only. Runs fully offline: no external or paid APIs, and no model downloads or local model weights.

non_goals.value: No authentication, no database, no web UI.

done.value: Sending a message returns a relevant AI-generated interpretation of the described symptoms.

data_model.value: Message(id, text, received_at); Reply(id, message_id, text, sent_at).

error_handling.value: An empty or oversized body returns 400 with a JSON error; an internal failure returns 500 without a stack trace.

seed_data.value: Ships empty; the first user creates all the data.
